data.name: defect_genome_pcfc_materials
data.title: Defect Genome PCFC
data.long_title: Defect Genome of Cubic Perovskites for Fuel Cells
data.description: Defect Genome of Cubic Perovskites for Fuel Cell Applications. Employing computationally tractable ab initio models driven by highly scalable workflows, to study formation and interaction of various point defects (e.g., O vacancies, H interstitials, and Y substitutional dopant), in over 80 cubic perovskites, for potential proton-conducting ceramic fuel cell (PCFC) applications.

data.name: esters
data.title: Esters BiSe
data.description: More accurate c-axis lattice parameter than what is currently on MP. The downside is that this calculation increases the error of the a-axis lattice parameter from 1.9% to 2.5%. The error in the c-axis lattice parameter, however, is decreased from 4.9% to 2.8%, and the error in the cell volume decreases from 8.9% to 7.9%.
